results.title: Lindsay Clancy has ‘bad days and worse days,’ must be monitored round-the-clock for suicide: psychologist
results.description: Lindsay Clancy has "bad days and worse days" at a hospital where she is monitored round-the-clock to ensure she doesn't take her own life, a psychologist testified Wednesday.

results.title: Radio bracelets help Bella Vista police locate missing residents with cognitive disabilities
results.description: For families caring for a loved one with dementia, autism or another cognitive condition, a small wearable bracelet has given the Bella Vista Police Department a 100% success rate in locating clients who have gone missing.

results.title: Phoebe Bridgers spends 32nd birthday hospitalized with appendicitis
results.description: The singer-songwriter, whose birthday is Aug. 17, had to postpone tour dates in the U.K.
